verdict.rationale: Stripe Atlas automatically performs fixed incorporation steps on the user's behalf, such as EIN filing, 83(b) elections, signature sequencing and share issuance. These are built-in, one-off process steps, not automations a user can configure to run autonomously in the background. The evidence documents no user-defined workflows, recurring schedules, triggers or agentic automation features, so the applicable axis is unsupported.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
